study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
cohort: 4,460 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies from the nuMoM2b study (2010-2014) who had normal BP up to 22 weeks gestation
finding: Elevated or stage 1 blood pressure after 20 weeks of pregnancy was found to be associated with a higher likelihood of hypertensive disorder of pregnancy, fetal growth restriction, and placental abruption.
